plagiarism_defense.legal_principle: Plagiarism requires unauthorized use of someone else's work

defense_points.argument: Organization owns the enterprise AI accounts that produced the outputs
defense_points.legal_basis: Enterprise service agreements grant output ownership to customer

defense_points.argument: AI was fed proprietary systems owned by the Organization
defense_points.legal_basis: Original work ownership + derivative work rights

defense_points.argument: FlameLang, TRIG6, SAGCO-OS do not exist in any training data
Organization members are authorized to use Organization IP
Complete transparency about AI usage and methodology

plagiarism_defense.conclusion: It is legally impossible to plagiarize content that is: (1) produced by AI accounts you own, (2) derived from proprietary systems you own, (3) explicitly granted to you as the customer per service agreements, and (4) properly attributed in your work.

verification_mechanisms.description: Methods for third parties to verify the legitimacy of IP claims

mechanisms.process: Verify Strategickhaos DAO LLC registration with Wyoming Secretary of State
Verify GitHub organization ownership and repository history
mechanisms.evidence: Public GitHub organization page and commit history

mechanisms.process: Review commit history showing evolution of proprietary systems
mechanisms.evidence: Git commit logs, contributor graphs, development timeline

mechanisms.process: Verify enterprise account ownership with privacy redaction
mechanisms.evidence: Account dashboard screenshots (with sensitive data redacted)
mechanisms.notes: Can be shown to appropriate authorities with privacy protections

mechanisms.process: Verify that proprietary systems don't exist in public codebases
mechanisms.evidence: Code search across GitHub, search engines, academic databases
mechanisms.expected_result: No matches for FlameLang syntax, TRIG6 functions, SAGCO-OS architecture

legal_disclaimers.general_disclaimer: This document establishes an IP chain of custody for Strategickhaos DAO LLC. It does not constitute legal advice and should not be relied upon as such. Consult with qualified legal counsel for specific situations.
legal_disclaimers.enterprise_agreement_disclaimer: References to enterprise AI service agreements are based on publicly available terms and organization's understanding of contractual obligations. Specific agreement terms may vary.
legal_disclaimers.academic_policy_disclaimer: This chain of custody does not override or replace institutional academic integrity policies. Organization members must comply with all applicable institutional requirements while maintaining transparency about their development methodology.
legal_disclaimers.verification_disclaimer: Verification mechanisms are provided for transparency. The Organization reserves the right to protect confidential business information while providing sufficient evidence of legitimate IP ownership.
legal_disclaimers.no_guarantee_disclaimer: This documentation does not guarantee acceptance of AI-assisted work by all institutions or evaluators. It provides a framework for transparent disclosure and IP ownership verification.
